notes: This book is built around a colour-animal repetition pattern, so the 11 fringe slots are best used for the six key colours (red, yellow, blue, green, purple, white, black — seven colours total) plus the four remaining named animals not covered by the hero (bird, duck, frog, cat). Horse, sheep, goldfish, teacher, and children are already in activity_images so they do not need fringe slots. The core row already contains 'colour' and 'see', which perfectly support the book's repeated 'What do you see?' refrain. The fixed core words 'same' and 'different' also support pattern discussion. Consider labelling each colour cell with both a colour swatch background AND the colour name text for maximum accessibility.
